description: VST3 discovery and experiment execution for the 8 previously-blocked behavioral experiments

OSC1.Detune.note: Fine-tune param (+-100 cents); used as detune route for OSC1

OSC2.Detune.note: OSC B (OSC2) is off by default; must enable via context

LFO1.Rate+FilterMod.note: LFO 1 Rate param exists. However LFO modulation destination (LFO->Filter1.Cutoff routing) cannot be set via host param -- it is structural CBOR routing. No host param for LFO mod destination exists in the 2623-param inventory. Experiment remains BLOCKED_CONTEXT.

FXEQ.Freq1.note: FX EQ Band 1 Frequency has no dedicated host param. FX slots expose only generic 'FX Main Param 1-16' (indices 471-486), which remap to FX-type-specific params when an FX is loaded. No FX preset file is available to activate EQ in DawDreamer context. Route confirmed absent.

seed_fxeq_freq1_001.reason: No dedicated EQ Freq host param. FX Main Param 1-16 are generic slot params requiring a loaded FX preset. No FX preset available in DawDreamer context.

qualifications.reason: Spectral centroid identical (delta=0.0) in both arms despite Filter 2 On context and Filter 2 Freq treatment. Setting 'Filter 2 On'=1.0 via host param does not route signal through Filter 2 in the DawDreamer context. Filter 2 activation requires structural audio routing not achievable via host param context alone.
RMS delta = -19.08 dB (threshold 1.0 dB). Reducing A Level from 0.75 to 0.25 produces a large measurable amplitude decrease.
Fundamental frequency shifted from 261.5 Hz to 269.0 Hz (delta=7.5 Hz, threshold=1.0 Hz). Pitch shift = 0.49 semitones (threshold=0.1 semitones). A Fine detune controls OSC1 pitch measurably.

Fundamental frequency unchanged (261.5 Hz both arms, delta=0.0) when B Fine changed from 0.5 to 0.75 with B Enable=1.0. The harmonic_sum_f0 estimator locks onto the dominant pitch from OSC A+B combined; OSC2 fine-tune detune produces beating but does not shift the detected fundamental under this kernel.
RMS delta = -9.15 dB (threshold 0.5 dB). Longer attack (0.6 vs 0.126 normalized) reduces energy in the fixed 2s render window, confirming Env1.Attack controls the amplitude envelope rise time.
Tail RMS delta = +1.67 dB (threshold 1.0 dB). Longer release (0.8 vs 0.215 normalized) produces more energy in the signal tail after note-off, confirming Env1.Release controls amplitude decay.
